_: SPINE — standards. CLERO's 33 National LERO Standards (Standards for lived experience recovery organisation community groups and providers, 2024), as the frame Community Recovery reads itself against: each standard in CLERO's own wording with its number, never anyone's opinion. The criteria and example evidence for each standard are CLERO's and are read in CLERO's own document, at https://www.clero.co.uk/clero-standards. Groups A and B hold more than nine standards, so each is gathered into small themed clusters, as Matthew gathered them at spine:community-recovery-standards on the apex beach, where his own first reading also stands. How it is read and answered is the family's law, function:standards.
